appDescription: A driving logbook for sales staff that records business trips, the client visits made at each stop, and upcoming plans on a calendar.

function.name: RECORD_CLIENT_VISIT
function.description: Save a note about a sales visit that already happened, for the trip the user is driving or has just finished, so it appears in the visit log.

summary.description: Short summary of what happened at the visit, in the user's language, at most 20 characters.

client.description: Name of the client company that was visited.

contact.description: Name and job title of the person the user met at the client.

followUp.description: The next task the user promised to do for this client.

followUpWhen.description: When the follow-up task is due, copied exactly in the user's own words without converting it to a date.

function.name: RECORD_SCHEDULE
function.description: Add a future plan to the user's calendar, such as a client meeting or something to remember on a certain day. Use this for things that will happen later, not for reporting a visit that already happened.

title.description: Short title of the plan, in the user's language, at most 20 characters.

when.description: The day of the plan, copied exactly in the user's own words without converting it to a date.

time.description: The time of day of the plan, copied exactly in the user's own words. Leave empty if the user did not say a time.

client.description: Name of the client company the plan is with, if any.

contact.description: Name and job title of the person the plan is with, if any.
